from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout with title and lecture lines
        self.setup_layout(
            "The Setup: A Strange Counting Game",
            [
                "Imagine two blocks on a frictionless surface.",
                "A wall sits to the far left.",
                "We count every bounce between blocks and the wall."
            ]
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(BLUE_B))
        
        # Draw floor and wall relative to grid points
        floor = Line(self.grid['F1'], self.grid['F6'], color=WHITE)
        wall = Line(self.grid['A1'], self.grid['F1'], color=WHITE)
        
        # Small block m (blue)
        block_m = Square(side_length=0.6, fill_opacity=0.8, color=BLUE_B)
        self.place_at_grid(block_m, 'E2')
        m_label = MathTex("m", color=BLUE_B)
        self.place_at_grid(m_label, 'D2')
        
        # Large block M (yellow)
        block_M = Square(side_length=1.0, fill_opacity=0.8, color=YELLOW_B)
        self.place_at_grid(block_M, 'E5')
        M_label = MathTex("M", color=YELLOW_B)
        self.place_at_grid(M_label, 'D5')
        
        self.play(Create(floor), Create(wall))
        self.play(FadeIn(block_m), FadeIn(m_label), FadeIn(block_M), FadeIn(M_label))
        
        # Block M starts sliding
        self.play(block_M.animate.move_to(self.grid['E3']), M_label.animate.move_to(self.grid['D3']), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        
        # Initialize collision counter
        counter_val = ValueTracker(0)
        counter_label = Text("Collisions:", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(counter_label, 'A3')
        
        counter_num = DecimalNumber(0, num_decimal_places=0, color=WHITE)
        counter_num.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(counter_val.get_value()))
        self.place_at_grid(counter_num, 'A4')
        
        self.play(FadeIn(counter_label), FadeIn(counter_num))
        
        # Show first collision: M hits m
        # Move both to collision point between E2 and E3
        collision_point_blocks = (self.grid['E2'] + self.grid['E3']) / 2
        self.play(
            block_M.animate.move_to(collision_point_blocks + RIGHT*0.4),
            M_label.animate.move_to(collision_point_blocks + RIGHT*0.4 + UP*0.8),
            block_m.animate.move_to(collision_point_blocks - RIGHT*0.4),
            m_label.animate.move_to(collision_point_blocks - RIGHT*0.4 + UP*0.8),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        
        # Increment counter
        self.play(counter_val.animate.set_value(1), Flash(collision_point_blocks, color=WHITE))
        
        # Block m moves towards wall
        self.play(
            block_m.animate.move_to(self.grid['E1'] + RIGHT*0.3), 
            m_label.animate.move_to(self.grid['D1'] + RIGHT*0.3),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW_B))
        
        # Block m hits wall
        wall_collision_point = self.grid['E1']
        self.play(
            block_m.animate.move_to(wall_collision_point + RIGHT*0.3),
            run_time=0.2
        )
        self.play(counter_val.animate.set_value(2), Flash(wall_collision_point, color=WHITE))
        
        # Block m bounces back and hits M again
        self.play(
            block_m.animate.move_to(collision_point_blocks - RIGHT*0.4),
            m_label.animate.move_to(collision_point_blocks - RIGHT*0.4 + UP*0.8),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        
        self.play(counter_val.animate.set_value(3), Flash(collision_point_blocks, color=WHITE))
        
        # Final slow movement away
        self.play(
            block_m.animate.move_to(self.grid['E1'] + RIGHT*0.8),
            m_label.animate.move_to(self.grid['D1'] + RIGHT*0.8),
            block_M.animate.move_to(self.grid['E4']),
            M_label.animate.move_to(self.grid['D4']),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(2)
